title: VAST G1-J5 song authoring dialect (input-only)
description: Compact, AI-friendly authoring format for the VAST G1-J5 web synthesizer (package name: websynth). On import the app expands this into the full canonical 'websynth-song' format (see websynth-song.schema.json) — the dialect is INPUT-ONLY and is never exported or persisted. Melody banks are positional note lists (rest-padded to 16 steps), drum/sampler banks are hit lists keyed by track name, and chains are strings like 'AABA'. Canonical runtime validation is src/state/song-author.ts (expandAuthorSong); this schema is the published machine-readable mirror. Note: the runtime normalizes drum-track keys (case/punctuation-insensitive, e.g. 'C.Hat' == 'chat'), which JSON Schema cannot express — this schema documents keys via additionalProperties and the runtime enforces them.

format.description: Required discriminator. Always the literal string 'websynth-song-author'.

params.description: SPARSE ParamBus snapshot: dotted parameter id -> scalar value (e.g. 'transport.bpm', 'filter.cutoff'). Set only what matters; every omitted param keeps its default.

seq.description: 0..4 melody banks (A/B/C/D). A missing bank is empty.

drums.description: 0..4 drum banks. Track keys: kick, snare, chat/hat/hihat/closedhat, ohat/openhat, ltom/lowtom, mtom/midtom, htom/hightom, clap, or '0'..'7'.

sampler.description: 0..4 sampler banks. Slot keys: 's1'..'s8' or '0'..'7'. Slots play user-loaded audio; audio is never embedded.

motion.description: 0..4 motion-sequencer banks: XY param automation over the bar. Each bank is an anchor list, or {assign, steps} to override which two params this bank drives (an unset axis inherits 'xy'). 'motion.slide' param: 1 (default) ramps linearly between anchors, 0 jumps and holds.

seqChain.description: Sequencer arrangement lane. Omitted = play bank A (chain disabled).

sampleNames.description: Display name per sampler slot (padded to 8 with null). Filenames only — the user loads the audio by hand.

xy.description: XY-pad axis assignment: which param each pad axis drives.

note.description: A pitch: MIDI number 0..127 or a note name like 'A2'/'C#4'/'Db3' (C4 = 60).

seqEntry.description: One melody step: null = rest, a note, or a note object with per-step settings. Sounded-step defaults: velocity 0.85, gate 0.5, prob 1, ratchet 1, tie false.

seqBank.description: One bar of melody (16 sixteenth-note steps): a positional entry array (short arrays are rest-padded) or the bank-defaults form {notes, ...settings} where the settings apply to every sounded step.

hit.description: One trigger: a step index 0..15 or a step object with per-step settings.

hitBank.description: One bar of triggers: track/slot key -> hit list. The runtime validates the keys (drum aliases or 's1'..'s8'/'0'..'7').

motionAnchor.description: One motion anchor: the assigned params' normalized 0..1 positions at a step (taper space, like the XY pad surface).

motionBank.description: One bar of XY automation: an anchor list, or {assign, steps} to override the driven params per bank.

chain.description: Arrangement lane, one bank per bar, looped: a bank-letter string ('.'/'-' = silent bar, spaces ignored), an index array (-1 = silent bar), or the full {enabled, steps} object. String/array shorthands imply enabled: true.
